subject: Post-call: Proof Cycle plan, success metrics, and milestone governance
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@cardinalai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap: proof cycle next steps and proposed milestone slate

Hi Priya / Evan — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and my proposed next steps so we have an agreed on ramp into a short, measurable proof cycle (we're calling this a "proof cycle" to emphasize a fast, gated evaluation):

Summary of objectives
- Validate Redwood inference end-to-end for Cardinal AI recommender: throughput at 400 qps peak, 95th pct latency < 120ms, and embedding drift within baseline thresholds.
- Confirm integration pattern for your streaming inference path and KV cache behavior.

Success criteria (provisional — please confirm):
1) Performance: 95th percentile latency < 120ms under a 200–400 qps profile for 1-hour sustained windows.
2) Cost: token/unit cost within 15% of our quoted estimate during the trial.
3) Quality: A/B sample of 500 queries with automated rerank agreement score >= 0.88 vs your current model.
4) Ops: Logs, audit trail, and model pinning working; ability to roll back to prior model.

Proposed timeline & cadence
- Week 0 (kickoff): onboarding, test data ingest, access, and runbook review.
- Week 1: baseline runs, infra tuning, initial KV cache and batching config.
- Week 2: mirrored workload runs, metric collection, and quality readouts.
- Week 3: final readout, handoff to your platform team, and options for Dedicated capacity.

Owners (high level)
- Redwood: Sean (trial owner), Marissa (integration engineer), Neha (SRE / metrics).
- Cardinal AI: Priya (product), Evan (platform).

Immediate asks (can you confirm by EOD Friday?):
- Agree / adjust the success criteria above.
- Confirm availability for a 60-minute kickoff: Tue 17 Nov or Wed 18 Nov (we're timezone-flexible).
- Share sample traffic profile and a non-production API key for a mirrored workload.

Attachments: runbook draft and success criteria spreadsheet attached. We'll fill in an explicit mutual action plan once you confirm.

Best,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales \u2014 Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: proof_cycle_runbook.pdf (runbook draft, 7 pages); mpo_success_criteria.xlsx (proposed metrics)

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@cardinalai.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Brooks <evan@cardinalai.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: proof cycle next steps and proposed milestone slate

Thanks Sean — this is very helpful and aligns with our internal goals. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Success criteria: the quality metric needs one tweak. Instead of absolute agreement score, can we measure "relative lift" vs our baseline on the 500-query sample (we expect >= +6% NDCG)?
- Timeline: we need a slightly longer mirror period to account for feature rollouts; can Week 2 be extended to 9 days if needed?
- Security: we'll require an export of the audit log schema before production data is used (non-prod API key fine for the mirror).

Availability: Tue 17 Nov looks tough for our platform folks. We can do kickoff Wed 18 Nov 10:00–11:00 PT.

Two quick asks for your runbook:
1) Add a short section on how Redwood handles model fallback (if we hit a degradation gate).
2) Confirm whether KV cache snapshots will be accessible to our engineers for debugging.

I'll loop in Evan for platform confirmations; he may have follow-ups on infra shape.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Shah
Head of Product \u2014 Cardinal AI
priya.shah@cardinalai.com | +1 (617) 234-9987

On Thu, Nov 12, 2026 at 2:22 PM Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com> wrote:

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@cardinalai.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: proof cycle next steps and proposed milestone slate

Hi Priya / Evan — Marissa here, technical lead for the trial. Thanks for the notes; I've updated the runbook and success spreadsheet (attached). Responses inline below and an updated, minimal plan we can execute if you want a compressed window.

On success criteria: we can report both absolute agreement and relative NDCG lift. We'll add a dual-metric tab in mpo_success_criteria.xlsx so your analysts have both views.

On timeline: extending Week 2 to 9 days is fine; we'll label it "mirror + stabilization" and build the gating window into the runbook.

On audit logs and KV cache:
- Audit schema: attached a JSON schema excerpt in the runbook appendix.
- KV snapshots: yes — we'll provide read-only access to snapshots from non-prod runs; scheduling for snapshot exports will be in the runbook.

Proposed milestone slate (condensed view):
- Wed 18 Nov (Kickoff, 60 min): runbook walk, access exchange, success gates aligned.
- Thu 19 Nov (Baseline run): 2-hour baseline with small sample to validate config.
- Mon 23 Nov  to Thu 2 Dec (Mirror + stabilization): 9 days of mirror traffic, continuous metrics collection.
- Fri 3 Dec (Final readout): results, decision to move to Dedicated or extend trial.

Owners:
- Redwood integration: Marissa (lead), Aditya (infrastructure tuning)
- Metrics & SRE: Neha
- Cardinal: Priya (product), Evan (platform)

I've attached: proof_cycle_runbook.pdf (v1.2) and weekly-checkins-agenda.docx; both include the fallback procedures you asked about.

If that slate looks good, Sean, can you lock the kickoff for Wed 18 Nov 10:00 PT and send a calendar invite with the agenda?

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Principal Solutions Engineer \u2014 Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (206) 555-0199

Attachments: proof_cycle_runbook.pdf (v1.2), weekly-checkins-agenda.docx

All good from our side. Wed 18 Nov 10:00 PT confirmed for kickoff. Quick notes:
- I'll provision a non-prod API key and a mirrored traffic capture for the baseline run; expect delivery by end of day Tue 17 Nov.
- Platform will want a short connectivity test 24 hours before kickoff; can Marissa/Aditya take that on?
- We're OK with the 9-day mirror window; we'll reserve capacity and flag any feature rollouts during that span.

Looking forward to the kickoff. I'll accept the invite when it's up.

Thanks,
